title: Starveil Barrage · Aerospace Defense Grid
description: An original pixel-art vertical defense shooter: pilot a generic aerospace interceptor, graze meteors, chain near misses and contain a three-phase catastrophic asteroid object.

defaultCaptions.x: Track the fall, time the intercept and protect the aerospace defense grid in Starveil Barrage.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Starveil Barrage is a pixel-art aerospace-defense bullet-hell remix. Graze hazards to charge your intercept burst, keep the chain alive and contain a three-phase asteroid threat.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I remixed a pixel-art vertical bullet-hell into an aerospace-defense mission with meteors, near misses, charged intercept bursts and a three-phase catastrophic object.
defaultCaptions.discord: Starveil Barrage: steer, graze and burst your way through the Meteor Corridor and Asteroid Front.
